description: Kept the grain out of the column.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Kept the sum on its own line, and would not have the foot flatter the week.
name: Humphrey Larkham

description: Read the week on the line, and set the share at thirty-four.
name: John Heminges

description: Took the shillings, and sent him home to sleep.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Asked for the figure plain, and kept Tuesday's name out of the book.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Told the share out with the name, and did not short it for the tooth.
name: Will Kemp

description: Took the stack, and did not rule it into the coffer.
name: William Shakespeare
